response.title: Online grievance registration
response.description: The system shall allow an applicant to register a grievance online against an application, with category and description, and shall route it to the District Social Welfare Officer of the applicant's district within 5 minutes of registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a grievance registered against an application, when it is saved, then a grievance number is shown and it appears in the DSWO's grievance list within 5 minutes.
response.rationale: Replaced the ambiguous "quickly" with a measurable routing time of 5 minutes.
